def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid))
    bands=[]; start=0
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(x == sep for x in row): bands.append((start,i)); start=i+1
    bands.append((start,h))
    spans=[]; start=0
    for j in range(w):
        if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(h)): spans.append((start,j)); start=j+1
    spans.append((start,w))
    counts={}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row: counts[v]=counts.get(v,0)+1
    bg=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    marker=next(v for v in counts if v not in (sep,bg))
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)) == 2 else bg for x,y in spans] for a,b in bands]
